concept.name: Min-max scaling
concept.definition: A linear transformation mapping the training minimum and maximum of a feature to a specified range, commonly zero to one.
concept.intuition: It controls what information the model receives and in what numerical representation.
concept.mechanics: Estimate the extrema on training data and apply the same affine transform out of sample, allowing later values to fall outside the range unless clipped.
concept.failure_modes: Fitting the operation on the full dataset leaks future information; revisions, outliers, and missing values can also distort results.
concept.misconceptions: A cleaner or rescaled dataset is not automatically more truthful; transformations must preserve timing and economic meaning.
concept.example: With training minimum 10 and maximum 30, value 20 maps to 0.5 and later value 40 maps to 1.5.
